comment: WORLDMAP.md 6.7. The world map carries 8 placeholder door events on the 4 of its 29 sites that have nothing behind them yet, and they are deliberately INERT: a page whose command list is just the terminator, so Game_Event.start never runs it. This asserts that in the engine rather than in the data, because the day somebody wires the first real transfer is the day this stops being true for one of them and nothing else would say so. Great Dunnage (31,52) and Village 1 (60,61) are the two walked onto here - Great Dunnage because it is SITES.md step 18, the last site to be built, so this walk will not have to move again until then. The Former Premises was the one placeholder that could only be reached by air, and it has been built, so every placeholder left is on the ground and walking onto two of them is the whole test.

steps.label: the world map is 120x120 and installed

8 placeholder doors left. It was 41 on 29 sites; Penultima's two, Restwell's two, the Hithermost cluster's four - Village A is two cells, and the chapel and the Door into the Mountain one each - Fairholme's three - Castle A is two cells, and Mrs Emberthwaite's lair one - Olde Evermore's one, Village C - Gladhollow's two, Village B is two cells - the Former Premises' two, Floating Continent (Castle) is two cells - and the seven world-map-only sites' seven, one cell each and no map behind any of them - and Tobias Frayne's one, House (Town) - and Frostwick's two, Town B (Snow) is two cells - and Coldbarrow's one, Temple A (Snow) - and the Sable Hart's one, House (Town) - and Little Gore's and Sump's, House (Village) and House (Desert), one cell each - and Ashcombe's two, Village A is two cells - and Weeping Bottom's one, Temple B - are real doors now and are in this game's own block of events, which is what wiring a site does - see WORLDMAP.md 7.6. This number goes down by the width of a stamp every time somebody builds a room, and that is the check
and every page of every one of them has no commands at all
with what the page used to say moved into the note, where the editor shows it and nothing runs it

steps.comment: Great Dunnage's western door cell is one square north. Walking onto it must start nothing.

steps.label: there is an event on this square
THE POINT: walking onto it starts nothing - no chime, no window, no transfer to a room that does not exist

steps.comment: Village 1, which section 8 keeps deliberately surplus and unnamed.

steps.label: and onto Village 1's door, which has no backstory and no room

steps.comment: The air-only events, asserted off the data: validate.py proves none of them can be walked to. The Former Premises' two are real doors now and not placeholders, and they still carry the note - drop it from a real door and validate.py silently stops making that assertion, which is SITES.md section 1's first trap.
